default_https_port_serialization.canonical_authority: the hostname normalized under existing V1 rules ONLY, with no port suffix
default_https_port_serialization.rule: After successful URL validation, omit the port component entirely, both when absent in the discovered URL and when explicitly equal to decimal 443. NEVER serialize :443 in canonical_primary_statement_url. This omission does NOT authorize accepting or stripping any other port.

percent_escape_syntax.grammar: PCT_ENCODED := '%' HEXDIG HEXDIG; HEXDIG := ASCII 0-9 / A-F / a-f

percent_escape_validation.input_scope: Every literal % in every component of the URL text supplied by existing official-discovery extraction/parsing or redirect-target handling, BEFORE any normalization can discard or rewrite a component. This is an admission gate, not a modification of durable raw discovery bytes.
percent_escape_validation.malformed_effect: FAIL CLOSED. No admitted canonical_primary_statement_url, no source_item_id derivation/admission, no primary request and no redirect follow. A malformed escape MUST NOT reach the safe request layer.
percent_escape_validation.no_repair: Never replace % with %25, strip %, decode a partial escape, guess a missing nibble, change an invalid character's case and retry, or preserve malformed % as a literal fallback.
order: 1. extract the official discovery URL from durable discovery provenance
2. parse using existing V1 URL policy
3. validate the already-frozen structural URL constraints
4. validate every literal % against percent_escape_syntax without decoding or rewriting the URL
5. if any escape is malformed, REJECT without repair
6. only after successful validation may existing normalization and identity derivation continue; all other existing admission checks still apply
7. only after successful validation may any request occur; the same percent gate is mandatory for a redirect target before it can be admitted for follow
percent_escape_validation.redirect_targets: Apply the SAME syntax gate to each target before final URL admission and BEFORE follow. For example https://www.federalreserve.gov/path%GG is rejected before request. Targets remain non-identifying; no other redirect rule is changed.
percent_escape_validation.scan_rule: At every literal %, require the next two characters to exist and belong to hex_characters. Consume that three-character escape, then continue scanning the remaining URL text. Ordinary following characters are not part of the escape. Validate syntax only: do not decode the represented octet or rescan decoded content.
percent_escape_validation.syntax_only: PASS means only that percent syntax is valid, never that the full URL or component is admitted. %00 and %FF pass this syntax gate just as %20, %2F, %2f, %7E and %7e do; every existing V1 component/security/primary-path restriction still applies.

port_admission.explicit_port_syntax: A present port token must consist entirely of one or more ASCII decimal digits 0-9, interpreted in base 10 with value in 0..65535. Leading zeroes do not change the decimal value; 0443 is decimal 443. No signs, whitespace, hexadecimal notation or partial-token parsing. Of syntactically valid explicit ports, ONLY value 443 is admitted.
port_admission.malformed_port_rule: An explicit port delimiter with an empty token, a non-numeric or partly numeric token, or an out-of-range value MUST fail closed. A malformed explicit port MUST NOT fall through as absent/default, even if a URL parser reports no numeric port. No library-specific exception class is prescribed.
port_admission.scope: Applies to every URL validated under V1's existing HTTPS/security policy, including official discovery links and EVERY redirect target BEFORE follow. Absent port or explicit decimal 443 is allowed; every other or malformed explicit port is rejected. Redirect targets remain NON-IDENTIFYING; admission never re-keys the discovered item. All other redirect/security rules are unchanged.

port_identity_effect.rule: With provider_id, event_family and all other accepted URL components equivalent under existing rules, absent port and explicit decimal 443 yield byte-identical canonical_primary_statement_url and the SAME source_item_id. Explicit default-port presence alone creates no source item, identity conflict or content revision.

port_normalization_order: 1. parse the official discovery URL under the existing URL policy; HTTPS admission remains mandatory
2. identify whether a port component is present; distinguish malformed/empty explicit port syntax from absence
3. if absent, accept the port condition without inventing an explicit port component
4. if present, validate the entire port token and parse its decimal value according to port_admission
5. reject malformed syntax or any value other than 443 BEFORE source_item_id derivation and BEFORE any request; no silent stripping or port rewrite
6. accept an explicit decimal value of 443, subject to all other existing URL validation requirements
7. serialize canonical identity authority WITHOUT a port component; keep every non-port URL normalization rule unchanged
url_canonicalization.query: V1 requires queryless canonical statement URLs; a query component is unexpected and fails closed
url_canonicalization.raw_explicit_port_spelling: PROVENANCE_ONLY - original discovered URL spelling, including explicit :443, remains available in the durable raw discovery artifact. NEVER mutate those raw bytes. The derived canonical identity URL omits the port; raw spelling is not canonical identity serialization.
url_canonicalization.raw_percent_escape_text: PROVENANCE_ONLY - malformed URL text may remain in the already-durable raw discovery artifact, unchanged. Raw preservation does not admit that URL. Reject the derived candidate; NEVER mutate raw source bytes to repair percent syntax.
url_canonicalization.raw_source_scheme_spelling: PROVENANCE_ONLY - original source spelling remains available in the durable raw discovery artifact. Do not rewrite those raw bytes to canonicalize identity. The derived canonical_primary_statement_url always uses lowercase ASCII https, regardless of original scheme spelling.

scheme_admission.comparison_rule: compare the parsed scheme to https after mapping ASCII A-Z to a-z only; no Unicode case folding or scheme inference

scheme_normalization_order: 1. extract the official discovery URL from durable discovery provenance
3. compare the parsed scheme against https ASCII case-insensitively
4. reject if the scheme is not HTTPS, including empty/missing scheme; no source_item_id admission or primary request
5. after successful HTTPS validation, serialize the identity URL scheme as exactly lowercase ASCII https
6. apply all OTHER existing V1 URL normalization rules unchanged; existing non-scheme validation requirements remain mandatory
url_canonicalization.valid_percent_escape_scope_boundary: FIX7 validates syntax ONLY. A valid escape already admitted under REV7 retains the existing path = preserved verbatim rule; this gate introduces no decoding or re-encoding. It does NOT decide canonical equivalence or hex-case normalization for %2f versus %2F, nor equivalence of %2F with /, %7E with ~ or %2E with a dot. Encoded dot segments, duplicate/trailing slashes and other URL policies are not redesigned here.

cycle_definition.backfill_isolation: HISTORICAL_BACKFILL backlog, failures or suspended entries never block a LIVE cycle; a manifest run never asserts zero
cycle_definition.channel_level_failure: a feed record's processing outcome is channel-level PARSER_FAILED when any feed-level stage fails (size, Content-Type, charset, UTF-8, XML security or syntax, channel structure); per-item defects are never channel-level
cycle_definition.conclusion_record: one durable, immutable cycle conclusion {cycle_id, B, result: EVENTS_OBSERVED_ZERO | NOT_ZERO, per-item classification, reasons}, committed in the same transaction as the feed record's classification or terminal failure outcome (including the owner's poison outcome), so a cycle-starting record is never FEED_RECORD_TERMINAL without its conclusion. If the feed record fails integrity verification, Content-Type, parsing or any other stage, the conclusion is NOT_ZERO with that reason.
cycle_definition.cycle_id: the per-response record id of the durable LIVE_ELIGIBLE feed record that starts the cycle
cycle_definition.evaluation: from the pre-cycle state and the cycle's own feed classification only; the result is fixed by those inputs
cycle_definition.immutability: later cycles, later observations, later revisions (including H2) and later retries never rewrite an earlier cycle conclusion
cycle_definition.items: every item listed by that feed observation
cycle_definition.newly_admitted: NEWLY_ADMITTED(C) = items whose LIVE feed candidate record was created by C and that have at least one IN_SCOPE_V1 LIVE outcome, whenever and through whichever LIVE observation it happens; reporting provenance only; not a complete event log: an item born from a clock-ineligible feed record belongs to no cycle
cycle_definition.no_cycle: a feed attempt whose outcome is non-qualifying, or whose record is not LIVE_ELIGIBLE, starts no cycle: the poll attempt is terminal, a durable CLOCK_INELIGIBLE (or failure) diagnostic is recorded, the record is still classified if PROCESSABLE, and polling cadence continues. Poll-attempt terminality is separate from cycle eligibility.
cycle_definition.pre_cycle_state: exactly the durable records with commit_seq < B; B is the commit_seq of the cycle's feed record, recorded in the cycle conclusion and unique per feed record
cycle_definition.recovery: a cycle-starting feed record without a conclusion is required local work (revision_policy.reobservation_scheduler.post_durable_processing.reconciliation); its conclusion is computed from its fixed pre-cycle state; no new feed poll is dispatched before it concludes. A feed record whose processing ends INTERNAL_PROCESSING_ERROR, CORRUPTION_FAIL_CLOSED or channel-level PARSER_FAILED gets a NOT_ZERO conclusion and becomes a failed-feed item.
cycle_definition.reobservation_independence: reobservation outcomes affect zero only through the item's durable state (outstanding_relevant_item.concluded); they never rewrite an earlier cycle conclusion
cycle_definition.starts_from: every LIVE_ELIGIBLE LIVE feed per-response record starts exactly one cycle

zero_assertion.design_alignment: design rev4 missingness_policy.never_encoded_as_zero = true; an item contributes to zero only when it is ITEM_SEMANTICALLY_CONCLUDED
zero_assertion.downstream_restriction: EVENTS_OBSERVED_ZERO from this provider MUST NOT be interpreted downstream as "the Federal Reserve/FOMC produced no monetary-policy event". No model or feature may treat it as a complete-world event count unless a future coverage contract establishes completeness. This binds later InformationSnapshot composition.
zero_assertion.forbidden_wording: never state "zero FOMC events" or equivalent without the capture-scope qualifier. This is a CAPTURE-SCOPE absence assertion, not a world-state one.

actions.MANUAL_RETRY: opens one MANUAL_RETRY episode for a named work item (retry_policy.manual_retry); valid only for LIVE_ACQUISITION, REOBSERVATION or HISTORICAL_BACKFILL work; concludes nothing
actions.RESOLVE: a decision about the item's durable state known at the resolution's own commit_seq (its cutoff); it creates no revision

operator_resolution.cutoff: a valid RESOLVE covers exactly the item records with commit_seq <= its own commit_seq; any later item record re-opens the item automatically. There is no hash-based or same-content exemption: a resolution is never a permanent permission.
operator_resolution.form: an explicit durable operator record {item_key: {kind: SOURCE_ITEM | UNIDENTIFIABLE_ITEM | FAILED_FEED, value}, action, reason text, operator identity}; never produced by automated code
operator_resolution.replay: operator records are ordinary records in commit_seq order
operator_resolution.validity: a RESOLVE is valid only if, at its commit_seq, every per-response item record is RECORD_PROCESSING_TERMINAL no LIVE episode or MANUAL_RETRY episode of LIVE work of the item is open, and no LIVE_ACQUISITION of the item lacks its EPISODE_OPEN (derivable terminal records are committed first). An invalid RESOLVE is recorded and concludes nothing.

outstanding_relevant_item.concluded: In a prefix, an item is ITEM_SEMANTICALLY_CONCLUDED iff EITHER (1) NATURAL: every per-response item record is RECORD_PROCESSING_TERMINAL, no LIVE episode or MANUAL_RETRY episode of LIVE work of the item is open (a derivable EPISODE_SUSPENDED or EPISODE_SUCCEEDED counts as committed), no marker exists after the latest valid resolution (or at all, if none), the processing outcome of the item's latest LIVE_ELIGIBLE record is a normalized IN_SCOPE_V1 outcome or DEFINITELY_OUT_OF_SCOPE, and every later PROCESSABLE LIVE record has an outcome of that same class (non-PROCESSABLE failures reopen nothing; they are attempt outcomes) (a later non-eligible record may reopen, never conclude); OR (2) RESOLVED: a valid RESOLVE exists and no item record has commit_seq greater than its commit_seq. Otherwise the item is OUTSTANDING. HISTORICAL_BACKFILL episodes never count here.
outstanding_relevant_item.failed_feed_clearing: a failed-feed item whose failure is PARSER_FAILED at channel level (provider-side malformed feed) is also CONCLUDED once a later feed record (greater commit_seq) is LIVE_ELIGIBLE and parses; INTERNAL_PROCESSING_ERROR and CORRUPTION_FAIL_CLOSED feed records (local defects) need an operator resolution. Stated V1 residual: an item listed only by feeds that were all malformed at channel level and gone by the next parseable feed is not captured.
outstanding_relevant_item.item_records: an item's durable records are its LIVE per-response records (including MANUAL_RETRY observations of LIVE work), their processing outcomes, its acquisition and episode records, and its markers (FEED_TITLE_CHANGED to feed_title_exact, INVALID_FEED_TITLE); GUID diagnostics are not markers; HISTORICAL_BACKFILL records are never item records for zero
outstanding_relevant_item.items: LIVE feed candidate records, unidentifiable-item records (feed_item_classification_v2 step 1) and failed-feed records (feed records whose processing ended INTERNAL_PROCESSING_ERROR or CORRUPTION_FAIL_CLOSED, or PARSER_FAILED at channel level)
outstanding_relevant_item.listing_independent: outstanding status does not depend on whether any later feed lists the item
not_concluded_examples: no LIVE_ELIGIBLE record yet (pending, retrying or suspended work)
latest LIVE_ELIGIBLE outcome, or a later LIVE outcome of another class, PARSER_FAILED, CLASSIFICATION_CONFLICT, IDENTITY_CONFLICT, CORRUPTION_FAIL_CLOSED or INTERNAL_PROCESSING_ERROR
a marker after the latest valid resolution
any item record after the latest RESOLVE cutoff
unidentifiable, unsupported-shape or failed-feed item without resolution
outstanding_relevant_item.scope: only LIVE feed candidates and LIVE observations; HISTORICAL_BACKFILL observations never make an item outstanding and never block LIVE zero (they may still change snapshot content state, snapshot_binding.mode_scope)

vocabulary.ITEM_SEMANTICALLY_CONCLUDED: defined by outstanding_relevant_item.concluded; zero depends only on this
vocabulary.RECORD_PROCESSING_TERMINAL: a PROCESSABLE record with a terminal processing outcome, or a non-PROCESSABLE per-response record whose attempt has an outcome

partial_cycle.example: Feed lists 3 new candidates; 2 conclude and 1 fails: the 2 are retained; the failed one stays an OUTSTANDING_RELEVANT_ITEM, so every later cycle is NOT_ZERO until it concludes or an operator resolves it
partial_cycle.rule: Candidate outcomes are independent. Successful durable observations, anchors, obligations and revisions of some candidates are retained when another candidate fails; there is no rollback. The cycle is NOT_ZERO.

preconditions_all_required: 1. the cycle's feed record is LIVE_ELIGIBLE (causal_predicates)
2. the raw feed artefact is durable and passes raw_policy.integrity_verification
3. the feed parse and Content-Type gate succeed
4. every PROCESSABLE LIVE feed record with commit_seq < B is FEED_RECORD_TERMINAL with commit_seq < B (item_predicate.feed_item_classification_v2)

5. the cycle's own classification creates no NEW_FEED_CANDIDATE, first-sighted UNIDENTIFIABLE_ITEM key or first-sighted UNSUPPORTED_DISCOVERY_SHAPE and raises no GUID_CONFLICT, GUID_COLLISION or FEED_TITLE_CHANGED diagnostic
6. the pre-cycle state (commit_seq < B) contains no OUTSTANDING item (zero_assertion.outstanding_relevant_item), whether or not the feed lists it
7. consequently nothing is newly admitted by this cycle
zero_assertion.scope_statement: EVENTS_OBSERVED_ZERO holds for one LIVE discovery cycle: its feed observation introduced no new or unresolved item, and no LIVE-discovered relevant item was outstanding in the durable pre-cycle state. It is scoped to the V1 subset and never claims that no FOMC action occurred.
zero_assertion.semantic_scope: ZERO CONFIRMED V1-SUBSET EVENTS. Precisely: "no new events matching federal_reserve_fomc_capture_v1's frozen V1 predicate were confirmed during this successful discovery cycle."
